audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Skill and First item read K'Sante, while whys[4] and whys[5] on the same page say Feast's true damage beats your armor and his first tank item out-bulks you.
audit.why: The mirror audit already flipped both rows to Cho'Gath on its side; leaving them here would have the two pages answer the same question differently.
audit.corrected: phases[4]/win[4] and phases[5]/win[5] set to Cho'Gath at 4/10 (the inverse of the mirror's 6/10), and phases[5].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and phases[5].why claimed the Iceborn timing as a fight window during the exact stretch the content layer says to stop dueling.
audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6s, Feral Scream 11s at rank 1, Feast 80/70/60s. Those numbers are what make levels 3-5 yours and the first-item window his.
audit.corrected: All three written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and tradeGood; phases[5].why now says farm rather than fight.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'percent-HP W' appears in four places. Feral Scream is flat magic damage plus a silence — it has no percent-health component. The percentHealth property belongs to Feast (R). The page also said 'Q3 to knock him up'.
audit.why: Telling a tank his armor is useless because of a percent-health W is wrong twice over: it misnames the threat and it hides the real one, which is an 11s silence that ends your combo mid-cast. Ntofo Strikes shockwaves at TWO stacks and PULLS.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream restated as a silence and Feast as the true damage in whys[5], spikes[2], late and wants.foe[2]; two-stack pull written into whys[2], spikes[0], wants.you[0] and tradeGood.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Rupture's cooldown.
edits.after: Feast stacks plus his first tank item out-bulk you — farm the wave instead of trading.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Rupture: matchup-defining — Telegraphed. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rupture: 6s flat — telegraphed delay, so walk out of the circle. - Feral Scream: 11s silence that ends your combo mid-cast. - Feast: 80s of true damage. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: This is where I have to respect him as a scaler — but it doesn't fully run away from me like Vayne or Fiora does. His Feast true damage and percent-HP W ignore my armor, so I can't bet on out-tanking him in a straight duel. What I can do is play the teamfight: with Iceborn Gauntlet and two items I have the bulk to charge through his slow Q-W-Feast combo with Path Maker's unstoppable window, then R their carry out of the fight. Don't sit in lane trying to solo a fat Cho'Gath — group, peel, and let my R win the 5v5 instead of his stacks winning the 1v1.
edits.after: This is where I have to respect him as a scaler — but it doesn't fully run away from me like Vayne or Fiora does. His Feast true damage and Feral Scream silence beat my armor, so I can't bet on out-tanking him in a straight duel. What I can do is play the teamfight: with Iceborn Gauntlet and two items I have the bulk to charge through his slow Q-W-Feast combo with Path Maker's unstoppable window, then R their carry out of the fight. Don't sit in lane trying to solo a fat Cho'Gath — group, peel, and let my R win the 5v5 instead of his stacks winning the 1v1.
